CAREER OBJECTIVE  
 
Data Governance Analyst with 3.5 years of hands-on experience in the Collibra Data Intelligence 
platform, specializing in Metadata Management, Data Catalog, Data Profiling, and Data Lineage 
and Data Quality. Seeking a challenging role in leveraging expertise in data governance and 
contributing to enterprise-wide data management initiatives.

experience in Financial Domain specializing in Collibra Data Governance, with strong expertise 
in Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Quality, Data Catalog and Data Lineage.  
• 4.2 years of experience in providing end-to-end Application Support and ensuring stable, 
high-quality operations for business-critical systems.
